diagnosis: The raw paths are long and complex enough, but the derived simulator representation collapses reclaim structure out of the usable state sequence.

implementation_stages.name: preserve_micro_sequence
requirements: store directional swing transitions rather than only cumulative progress metrics
retain timestamps for swing inflection points
label early adverse, recovery, reclaim, and continuation segments

implementation_stages.name: side_aware_pricing_trace
requirements: attach bid, ask, or deterministic proxy prices to path state
record bar-1 fill audit with mismatch flags

implementation_stages.name: truth_anchor_overlay
requirements: derive total_available_pips and best-achievable path capture
publish entry-only and realized comparison alongside efficiency band

implementation_stages.name: balanced_benchmark_windows
requirements: weight benchmark runs across compressed, neutral, strong bullish, and strong bearish regimes
report raw and weighted outcomes separately
block promotion when one regime dominates benchmark evidence

downstream_policy: Re-run benchmark stack before any further form tuning.
Re-run AEE family audit only after simulator truth anchors are available.
Use expected_vs_actual_signature and failure_layer_classification artifacts on reconstruction validation.
